feature: Collection quick filters, PR 4: the combos view
note: One route, two sides, four widths. `?combos=both` is Two-card combos pressed on the Own both side; `?combos=one` is the Own one side. At 1180 and 1300 a pair is a card with its actions (Find a deck or Add to wishlist, and How it works); at 390 and 820 (below the chassis breakpoint, so the phone row by the same rule as the chip strip) a pair is one whole-row press that opens the pair's sheet. The other pages that use the filter chassis are unchanged: the view is a body branch of the Collection browser and the chassis takes only a result count and line.
